The Phantom Menace is also posted under Effects, so the deck plays two.
The list as published totals 58 cards, not 60; the counts are kept as published.
Format is Premiere - Coruscant: the Objective, Allegations Of Corruption, P-59 and P-60 are Coruscant cards, and the description says the deck was built after Coruscant came out.

Posted 'Bossk in Bus' dested Bossk In Hound's Tooth; 'Zuckuss in Ship' Zuckuss In Mist Hunter; 'Boba in Ship' Boba Fett In Slave I.

Posted 'S&D' dested Search And Destroy; 'Blast Door Control' Blast Door Controls; 'Blockade Flagship Bridge' Blockade Flagship: Bridge; 'Tat. Cantina' Tatooine: Cantina. Secret Plans is the Effect (not a Defensive Shield).

The 19 August update in the strategy adds 2 Maul's Lightsaber, Xizor, 2 Destroyer Droids, Maul's ship and Security Precautions, removes one each of Darth Vader With Lightsaber, P-59, P-60 and Darth Maul, and suggests starting Secret Plans instead of The Phantom Menace; the list here is the one posted.
